submergence_result.question: When was this exact place flooded?
submergence_result.answer: The current best model places the point on oceanic crust created about 96.1 Ma ago. Oceanic crust is created at a spreading ridge as seafloor, so the clean physical model is not LAND_THEN_FLOODED but RIDGE_BIRTH_AS_SEAFLOOR -> COOLING_SUBSIDENCE -> SEDIMENTATION.

regional_context.south_atlantic_rifting: major Early Cretaceous rifting roughly 145-125 Ma in modern reconstructions
regional_context.angola_sector_oceanic_crust_generation: commonly placed around ~110 Ma with model dependence and northward propagation
regional_context.deep_gateway: developed later over several Myr; regional gateway timing is not the local crust-formation age

age_confidence_firewall.seton_2020_rule: Crust within the Cretaceous Normal Superchron is assigned lower confidence because magnetic reversal constraints are sparse; the equatorial Atlantic is additionally difficult because magnetic anomaly signatures are weak in this geometry.
age_confidence_firewall.interpretation: 96.0988 Ma is a model-grid estimate, not a precise radiometric date. Future direct magnetic/seismic constraints may shift it.

plate_motion_first_order.model: Muller et al. 2019 optimized absolute reference frame as distributed in EarthByte presentday-agegridding
plate_motion_first_order.meaning: This is first-order absolute-frame displacement of a point assumed fixed to African plate 701, not cumulative seafloor-spreading distance and not validated local static-polygon assignment.

direct_data_gate.important_boundary: This is a catalog/provenance result, not proof that no ship has ever sounded the area. It does establish that the current globally available surface used here is not authorized for fine artificial-morphology inference.

causal_constraints: A feature physically rooted in this oceanic crust cannot predate the crust itself without later transport/emplacement.
The exact point is not modeled as former continental land that was suddenly flooded in human antiquity.
Regional Aptian-Albian marine transgression on the African continental margin must not be substituted for the local oceanic-crust birth clock.
The ~5.065 km GMRT depth is a synthesis value and cannot be used to infer geometric structures at meter scale.
No morphology search is admitted until direct bathymetry or seismic data are obtained at the frozen point.
